title.original: DebugLM: Learning Traceable Training Data Provenance for LLMs
title.zh: DebugLM：学习LLM的可追溯训练数据来源
title.en: DebugLM: Learning Traceable Training Data Provenance for LLMs

inclusion_reason.zh: DebugLM 把来源标签、行为归因接口和测试时缓解控制面嵌入训练管线，形成可复用的数据调试基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: DebugLM embeds source tags, behavior-attribution interfaces, and a test-time remediation control plane into training, forming reusable data-debugging infrastructure.

abstract.zh: DebugLM 在多阶段训练中为数据源引入可学习的来源标签，使模型能够把自身回答追溯到负责的数据集，并在推理时针对指定来源触发定向拒答。
abstract.en: DebugLM introduces learnable provenance tags across multi-stage training so a model can trace responses to responsible datasets and selectively refuse content associated with a specified source at inference time.

problem.zh: 开发者通常无法定位某个失败行为究竟来自哪段训练流程或数据源，只能反复补丁式修复，模型更新后问题还可能再次出现。
problem.en: Developers typically cannot locate which training stage or dataset produced a failure, reducing debugging to patches that may recur after distribution shifts or model updates.

approach.zh: 训练阶段把唯一数据源标签与样本和响应关联，模型学习输出来源归属；部署阶段利用归属结果定位问题数据，并无需改参数即可施加来源级拒答。
approach.en: During training, unique source tags are associated with examples and responses; at deployment, predicted attribution identifies problematic data and enables source-level refusal without parameter updates.

system_design.zh: 来源标记贯穿预训练和后训练数据管线，模型侧提供行为—数据集关联，调试控制面据此查询责任来源并下发测试时缓解策略。
system_design.en: Source tags flow through pretraining and post-training, the model exposes behavior-to-dataset associations, and a debugging control plane queries those associations and applies test-time remediation policies.

key_results.zh: 实验表明该框架能够在多阶段训练中准确追踪行为来源，并在保持模型总体效用的同时执行定向缓解。
key_results.en: Experiments show accurate behavior tracing across multi-stage training and targeted remediation while preserving the model's broader utility.

limitations.zh: 方法要求从训练开始就具备来源标签与管线控制权，主要归因到数据集而非单个样本；模型学到的标签关联也不等同于严格因果证明。
limitations.en: The method requires provenance labels and pipeline control from training time, attributes mainly at dataset rather than example level, and learned tag associations are not a formal causal proof.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件与基线均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未给出可安全转录的结果数字，表格明细与部署配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, and baselines come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; the abstract provides no result number safe to transcribe, and table details plus deployment configuration still require full-text audit.
